config.barehanded.title: Sable Barehanded
config.barehanded.option.maxForce.toolti: Maximum spring force applied to move a grabbed object.
config.barehanded.option.minDistance.too: Minimum hold distance from the player's eye to the anchor.
Extra reach added on top of the block-interaction-range attribute.
config.barehanded.option.blockLimit.tool: Maximum number of connected blocks that can be grabbed at once. 0 = unlimited.
Minimum mass required for an object to be grabbable (prevents grabbing tiny particles).
config.barehanded.option.creativeSuperSt: Creative players ignore weight limits and get boosted physics.
config.barehanded.option.spectatorSuperS: Spectator players ignore weight limits and get boosted physics.
config.barehanded.option.strengthLevelMu: Force multiplier per strength level. Formula: 1 + (level × multiplier). Works with any strength level.
config.barehanded.option.preventPropSurf: Prevents players from flying by standing on the object they are grabbing.
config.barehanded.option.preventGrabbing: Prevents players from grabbing sub-levels while seated on entities or other sub-levels.
config.barehanded.option.allowSpectatorG: Allows players in spectator mode to grab objects (ghost interaction).
config.barehanded.option.enableDistanceS: Allows players to adjust the grab distance using the scroll wheel.
config.barehanded.option.dynamicScrollMa: Automatically matches the max scroll distance to the player's reach.
config.barehanded.option.preventGravityI: Stops blocks like sand or gravel from falling down while they are part of a grabbed structure.
config.barehanded.option.allowGrabbingSp: Overrides all restrictions to explicitly allow grabbing Monster Spawners.
config.barehanded.option.useWhitelistMod: If true, ONLY blocks in the #barehanded:grabbable tag can be grabbed. If false, all blocks except those in #barehanded:ungrabbable can be grabbed.
config.barehanded.option.allowGrabbingUn: Allows grabbing blocks with destroySpeed < 0 (bedrock, barriers, etc). In whitelist mode, these blocks must also be in #barehanded:grabbable.
config.barehanded.option.preventGrabbing: Prevent Grabbing Sub-Levels with Ungrabbable Blocks
If true, prevents grabbing an entire sub-level if it contains any block from the #barehanded:ungrabbable tag.
Allows players to rotate grabbed objects using the mouse.
config.barehanded.option.cameraLockedRot: Grabbed object automatically tilts up and down with your camera.
Grabbed object automatically turns left and right with your camera.
config.barehanded.option.rotationStabili: How rigidly the object holds its rotation when idle (0 = loose, 1 = rigid).
config.barehanded.option.maxRotationSpee: Maximum allowed rotation speed per tick (radians).
config.barehanded.option.preventFastRota: Clamps rotation speed to prevent physics explosions from fast mouse flicks.
config.barehanded.option.rotationMassDam: How much object mass slows down rotation input.
config.barehanded.option.rotationTicksWi: Ticks the rotation motor stays active after the last mouse input.
config.barehanded.option.rotationRebuild: Angle (radians) that triggers a constraint pivot rebuild to prevent twisting.
config.barehanded.option.angularBrakeThr: Angle (radians) where the angular brake activates.
config.barehanded.option.angularBrakeMul: Damping multiplier when angular brake is active.
config.barehanded.option.enableBarehande: Allows players to pull and detach connected blocks from the world.
config.barehanded.option.enableRipOffBlo: Allows tearing individual blocks off a grabbed sub-level using sneak.
config.barehanded.option.barehandedAssem: Multiplier for the time it takes to pull blocks out of the world.
Maximum distance from the player to start pulling blocks.
config.barehanded.option.assemblyServerD: Server-side grace distance added when validating assembly requests.
config.barehanded.option.assemblyClientD: Client-side grace distance before cancelling the pull charge.
config.barehanded.option.fastLiftAssembl: Charge ticks for blocks with a BlockEntity but non-full collision (chests, barrels...).
config.barehanded.option.pullThreshold.t: Distance the player must pull back to advance the assembly charge.
config.barehanded.option.pullResistanceM: How much the pulled object resists the player's movement.
config.barehanded.option.assemblyMovemen: Dampens player movement while actively charging a detach.
config.barehanded.option.assemblyTetherS: Elastic stiffness when the player stretches beyond the max detach distance.
config.barehanded.option.assemblyMaxStre: Absolute maximum distance before the assembly charge forcefully breaks.
config.barehanded.option.enablePhysicsBl: Allows placing blocks directly as physics objects using the toggle key.
config.barehanded.option.enableImpactDis: Slam a grabbed sublevel into a world block to disassemble it.
config.barehanded.option.impactForceThre: Minimum impact force (mass × delta velocity) required to trigger disassembly.
Minimum velocity the object must have to trigger an impact check. 0.5-0.8 recommended.
config.barehanded.option.impactContactDi: Maximum distance from sublevel face to world block to register collision.
config.barehanded.option.impactSlowdownR: Percentage of speed loss per tick required to detect impact (0.15 = 15%). Lower = more sensitive.
config.barehanded.option.impactRequireIn: Only disassemble when the player actively throws the object (faster than player). Prevents accidental disassembles.
config.barehanded.option.impactThrowSpee: How much faster the object must move compared to the player to count as a throw.
config.barehanded.option.impactBreakRepl: Automatically break non-solid blocks (flowers, grass, buttons, saplings) before disassembling into the solid block behind them.
config.barehanded.option.impactRotationT: Maximum rotation deviation from grid alignment (multiples of 90°) for impact disassembly.
config.barehanded.option.impactPositionT: Maximum position deviation from block grid (integer coords) for impact disassembly.
config.barehanded.option.enableKeybindDi: Allows pressing a keybind (default Q) to disassemble an aligned sublevel.
config.barehanded.option.showDisassemble: Shows success or error messages in the action bar when disassembling.
config.barehanded.option.keybindRotation: Maximum rotation deviation from grid alignment for keybind disassembly.
config.barehanded.option.keybindPosition: Maximum position deviation from grid for keybind disassembly.
config.barehanded.option.disassembleBloc: Maximum number of blocks a grabbed structure can have to allow disassembly. 0 = unlimited.
config.barehanded.option.enableEncumbran: Enables player movement and camera penalties based on grabbed object mass.
Gravity constant (m/s^2) used to convert mass into resting force (Weight = Mass × Gravity).
config.barehanded.option.maxMovementPena: Maximum speed reduction (0.85 = 85% slower) when holding heavy objects.
config.barehanded.option.jumpPreventionT: Encumbrance ratio (0.0 to 1.0) at which jumping is disabled.
config.barehanded.option.sneakPrevention: Encumbrance ratio (0.0 to 1.0) at which sneaking is disabled.
config.barehanded.option.maxCameraPenalt: Maximum camera sensitivity reduction when holding heavy objects.
config.barehanded.option.scrollSpeedRedu: Reduces scroll interpolation speed for heavy objects (0 = no reduction, 1 = max reduction).
config.barehanded.option.enablePhysicalT: Enables the physical pull-back when stretching arms beyond the limit.
config.barehanded.option.armStretchToler: Extra distance (m) arms can stretch before the tether pulls the player.
config.barehanded.option.tetherStiffness: Base pull strength of the tether when stretched.
Additional pull strength based on the object's encumbrance.
config.barehanded.option.tetherVerticalS: Reduces vertical yanking to prevent the player from being launched into the air.
config.barehanded.option.recoilVelocityT: Minimum away-velocity required for the object to apply a recoil/pullback force.
config.barehanded.option.tetherHardEscap: Hard distance limit where the tether forcefully strips away-velocity to prevent escaping.
config.barehanded.option.enableExhaustio: Consumes player hunger based on physical effort when grabbing objects.
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionIdleR: Exhaustion added per tick just by holding a heavy object in the air.
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionMovem: Exhaustion multiplier based on player walking/jumping speed while holding weight.
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionTensi: Extra exhaustion multiplier when pulling against a stuck heavy object.
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionForce: Exhaustion multiplier based on kinetic energy (moving heavy blocks fast).
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionPassi: Weight in Newtons that is considered 'free' to hold without any effort.
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionSuppo: Relative height below which the object is considered partially supported by the ground.
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionLowSu: Reduces exhaustion effort when the object is resting on the ground.
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionMaxOv: Maximum over-stretch distance factored into tension exhaustion.
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionKinet: Block speed (m/t) at which kinetic exhaustion reaches its maximum.
config.barehanded.option.exhaustionVerti: Multiplier for vertical player movement (jumping) when calculating exhaustion.
config.barehanded.option.standingOnGrabS: Ticks physics stays suspended after stepping off a grabbed object.
config.barehanded.option.grabProximityEy: Eye-to-block distance that suspends physics to prevent clipping.
config.barehanded.option.grabProximityBo: Foot-to-block distance that suspends physics to prevent clipping.
config.barehanded.option.tensionSuspendT: Tension distance that temporarily suspends physics motors to prevent jitter.
config.barehanded.option.tensionBreakThr: Tension distance that forcefully breaks the grab.
config.barehanded.option.creativeTension: Tension suspend threshold in Creative Super Strength mode.
Tension break threshold in Creative Super Strength mode.
config.barehanded.option.maxPlayerVeloci: Maximum upward velocity allowed while grabbing.
Maximum downward velocity allowed while grabbing.
Maximum horizontal velocity allowed while grabbing.
config.barehanded.option.ignoreCollision: Prevents the grabbed object from colliding with the grabber.
Prevents the grabbed object from colliding with other players.
Prevents the grabbed object from colliding with mobs/entities.
Makes the grabbed object completely non-collidable (Ghost mode).
config.barehanded.option.selfCollisionIg: Squared distance to force-ignore self-collision to prevent physics penetration loops.
config.barehanded.option.ignoreCollision: Prevents collisions with the grabber while actively rotating.
Prevents collisions with other players while rotating.
Prevents collisions with mobs/entities while rotating.
Makes the object completely non-collidable while rotating.
config.barehanded.option.stiffness.toolt: Base linear spring stiffness. Higher = more rigid but can cause jitter.
config.barehanded.option.damping.tooltip: Base linear spring damping. Higher = less bouncing/overshoot.
Base angular (rotational) damping. Prevents objects from spinning endlessly.
config.barehanded.option.creativeStrengt: Multiplies stiffness, damping and force in Creative Super Strength mode.
config.barehanded.option.speedStiffnessM: Factor scaling spring stiffness with player speed. Keeps object close when running.
config.barehanded.option.maxSpeedStiffne: Cap on the speed-based stiffness multiplier.
config.barehanded.option.baseAngularForc: Fraction of maxForce used as minimum angular force.
config.barehanded.option.stableAngularFo: Constant term in the stable angular force formula.
Mass coefficient in the stable angular force formula.
config.barehanded.option.rotatingAngular: Base angular stiffness multiplier while actively rotating.
Range component of the rotation stiffness multiplier.
config.barehanded.option.swayAngularStif: Base angular stiffness multiplier when idle (sway mode).
Range component of the idle sway stiffness multiplier.
config.barehanded.option.minAngularForce: Minimum rotational torque applied to small/light objects to keep them responsive.
config.barehanded.option.stabilizationEx: Exponent applied to stabilization factors for non-linear rigidity curves.
config.barehanded.option.creativeMaxMoto: Maximum numeric force limit for physics motors in Creative mode to prevent engine overflow.
config.barehanded.option.heavyObjectMass: Multiplier for the logarithmic mass curve. Makes heavy objects feel heavier.
config.barehanded.option.heavyObjectMaxF: Allows motors to pull slightly harder on massive objects to prevent permanent stalling.
config.barehanded.option.grabElasticityS: Reduces linear stiffness slightly to simulate an organic, elastic grab.
config.barehanded.option.grabElasticityD: Reduces linear damping slightly to complement grab elasticity.
config.barehanded.option.swayStiffnessEd: Base sway multiplier when holding objects from edges (0 = Free Gravity Pivot).
Range sway multiplier when holding objects from edges.
config.barehanded.option.freePivotDampin: Friction applied when the object hangs freely to prevent endless swinging.
config.barehanded.option.baseMovementPen: Base movement speed reduction when holding any object.
config.barehanded.option.weightPenaltyMu: How much object weight increases movement penalty.
config.barehanded.option.tensionPenaltyM: How much pulling against tension increases movement penalty.
config.barehanded.option.kineticPenaltyM: How much block movement (falling/dragging) increases movement penalty.
config.barehanded.option.minSpeedWhileGr: Minimum movement speed allowed while grabbing (prevents complete freeze).
config.barehanded.option.tensionPenaltyS: Tension distance before movement penalty starts applying.
config.barehanded.option.tensionPenaltyM: Tension distance at which movement penalty reaches its maximum.
config.barehanded.option.kineticPenaltyR: Block speed at which kinetic movement penalty reaches its maximum.
config.barehanded.option.leadVelocityThr: Player speed threshold to activate target prediction.
config.barehanded.option.leadPredictionF: Multiplier for predicting the anchor target ahead of the player's movement.
config.barehanded.option.leadDownwardCla: Clamps downward prediction to prevent the object from being dragged into the floor.
config.barehanded.option.sableRagdollsCo: Maximum mob size (bounding box width/height) that can be grabbed.
config.barehanded.option.treeAssemblyMod:
AUTO: Uses BREAK mode if a tree mod is loaded, otherwise NONE.
NONE: No special handling; tree logs assemble into physics SubLevels as normal.
BREAK: Breaks the log block to trigger the tree mod's native felling behavior.
BLOCK: Prevents assembling tree logs.
config.barehanded.option.verticalRotatio: Mouse sensitivity for rotating grabbed sub-levels up/down.
config.barehanded.option.horizontalRotat: Mouse sensitivity for rotating grabbed sub-levels left/right.
config.barehanded.option.scrollDistanceS: Speed at which the distance adjusts using the mouse wheel.
config.barehanded.option.rotateAroundCen: If true, grabbed sub-levels rotate around their center of mass by default instead of the grab point.
config.barehanded.option.hideHandsWhileG: Forces First-Person and Third-Person arms to be hidden.
config.barehanded.option.hideFirstPerson: Hides the custom outstretched arms in first person when grabbing.
config.barehanded.option.hideThirdPerson: Hides the custom outstretched arms in third person when grabbing.
config.barehanded.option.armTransitionSp: How fast the arms raise when grabbing a block.
config.barehanded.option.assemblyShakeMu: How intensely the screen/arms shake while tearing a block from the world.
config.barehanded.option.preventAssembly: Stops barehanded assembly from triggering if the block is actively being mined.
config.barehanded.option.barehandedAssem: Mining progress threshold required to cancel an accidental assembly attempt.
config.barehanded.option.unsneakOnTreeBr: Temporarily un-sneaks the player while breaking tree logs to trigger tree-felling mods (e.g. FallingTree).
config.barehanded.option.hidePhysicsPlac: Hides permanent Physics Placement HUD overlay.
config.barehanded.option.showPhysicsPlac: Shows temporary message when toggling physics placement.
message.barehanded.disassemble.merge_fai: Merge Failed: Poor alignment or invalid angle.
message.barehanded.disassemble.structure: Structure is too large to disassemble (Limit: %s)
config.barehanded.option.preventMovement: Locks player movement inputs while actively rotating a grabbed object.
